name: Albert Cohen
title: CEO and Founder
about: Albert Cohen is the founder of Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C., a premier New York personal injury law firm. A rare combination of skill, tenacity, and fierce advocacy, Albert Cohen is an unwavering champion for his clients, relentlessly pursuing maximum recovery—far exceeding expectations.

Mr. Cohen’s meticulous approach to case preparation, combined with his highly experienced team of attorneys and paralegals, has resulted in numerous multi-million-dollar verdicts and settlements. The firm’s attorneys are widely recognized for their deep understanding of the law and their ability to provide strategic, client-centered legal counsel. Known for their expertise and unwavering dedication, Mr. Cohen and his team consistently achieve favorable outcomes. Their success has distinguished Cohen & Cohen as one of the most prestigious law firms in New York City, solidifying its reputation as a leader in personal injury litigation, appellate practice, and as expert car accident lawyers in NYC as well as top premises liability lawyers in New York.

Albert Cohen is deeply committed to charity and community service. An active leader in his community, he has provided significant pro bono legal services over the years. His contributions have earned him a Community Leadership Award from U.S. Senator Charles E. Schumer and a Proclamation from the New York City Council in recognition of his outstanding service.

Mr. Cohen is a distinguished member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum, an elite group of trial lawyers in the United States, where membership is limited to attorneys who have secured million-dollar verdicts and settlements, an honor held by less than 1% of U.S. lawyers. He has also earned a Superb rating from AVVO, the highest rating bestowed by the organization.

Mr. Cohen earned his Juris Doctor degree cum laude from Pace University School of Law and completed his undergraduate studies at Cleveland State University. He resides in Queens, New York, with his wife, a retired immigration judge and member of the firm, and their three children.

In his free time, Mr. Cohen enjoys reading, traveling, and exploring the outdoors. A published author and dedicated philanthropist, he continually seeks to elevate his professional leadership skills for the benefit of his firm and clients.

name: Raisa Cohen
title: Immigration Attorney
about: Hon. Raisa Cohen is a distinguished immigration attorney, founder of Cohen Immigration Law Group, and a veteran Immigration Judge with a profound commitment to justice and human rights. Born in Uzbekistan, she immigrated to the United States as a refugee, bringing with her a deep understanding of the immigrant experience.

Judge Cohen’s legal career commenced in private practice, where she specialized in immigration law. She then served as Assistant Chief Counsel for U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement at the Department of Homeland Security in New York. In March 2016, she was appointed as an Immigration Judge at the New York Federal Plaza Immigration Court, where she presided over complex immigration matters, including removal proceedings, bond hearings, and matters involving national security and human rights violations. Throughout her tenure on the bench, Judge Cohen was known for her fairness and integrity.

After nearly a decade of judicial service, Judge Cohen retired and returned to private practice in Queens, New York, where she continues to focus on asylum, removal defense, family-based immigration, and humanitarian cases. Her comprehensive experience as a former immigrant, private practitioner, prosecutor, and judge provides her with a unique and holistic perspective on immigration law and advocacy.

Following her retirement as an Immigration Judge, Judge Cohen has been called upon regularly to teach and speak in a variety of settings. She has guest lectured at law schools, presented at annual immigration symposiums and CLE training conferences. She remains actively involved in the legal community, mentoring the next generation of lawyers and contributing to discussions on immigration policy and reform.

Judge Cohen earned her Bachelor of Business Administration from Baruch College, City University of New York Zicklin School of Business in 2002, followed by a Juris Doctor from St. John’s University School of Law in 2007. She is a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA) and a member of the prestigious Roundtable of Former Immigration Judges.
Hon. Cohen is married to Albert Cohen, a founder and owner of Cohen and Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. Together, they raise three children and enjoy traveling and philanthropy.
Her journey from immigrant to Immigration Judge embodies the essence of the American dream and serves as an inspiration to many.

name: Jared Hatcliffe
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Professor Jared Hatcliffe brings nearly three decades of courtroom experience to the classroom. He spent his career with the New York City Law Department, rising to Senior Trial Counsel and trying hundreds of cases in state and federal courts. His cases included allegations of police misconduct and excessive force, including shootings and taser use, as well as civil rights violations, employment discrimination, medical malpractice, negligent design, premises liability, and automobile liability. Many involved catastrophic injury and wrongful death damages.

Professor Hatcliffe is now a Senior Trial Attorney at Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. His practice focuses on catastrophic injury cases, including medical malpractice, construction accidents, premises liability, employment discrimination, municipal liability, and automobile accidents. He represents clients at every stage, from settlement and mediation through arbitration and trial. His years on the defense side give him a detailed understanding of how insurers and government entities evaluate risk and defend claims, and he now brings that perspective to the plaintiff’s side.

At the Elisabeth Haub School of Law, Professor Hatcliffe is the Associate Director of the Advocacy Program. Graduating classes have voted him the Barbara C. Salken Outstanding Adjunct Professor of the Year three times (2021–2022, 2023–2024, and 2024–2025), and in 2022 he received the Loretta Musial Service Award from the Pace Trial Advocacy Department. He has also taught at Stetson University College of Law, John Jay College of Criminal Justice, Pace University’s Paralegal Certificate Program, and the National Institute for Trial Advocacy, and has lectured at the University of Oxford. He also served as a moderator and instructor for the Law Department Tort Division’s in-house trial training program.

He is the author of Trial Advocacy: The Art of Storytelling – Strategies for Winning a Trial in New York State Court (Carolina Academic Press, 2022) and co-author, with Morse and Gorman, of the third edition of New York Criminal Procedure: An Analytical Approach (2022). He is the founder and manager of The Advocate’s Advantage, Pace Haub Law’s official Trial Advocacy Program blog.

name: Ryan Charder
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Ryan Charder is a natural litigator known for vigorously fighting for injured clients. He prides himself on helping injured individuals take on insurance companies to obtain the maximum recovery for the wrongful acts of others. Mr. Charder has a keen ability to navigate clients through the rough waters of litigation.

Mr. Charder has vast experience obtaining recovery for his clients from settlement, mediation, arbitration, and trial. Notably, Mr. Charder obtained a settlement of $1,250,000 on behalf of a client riding a motorcycle who was injured by a careless driver making a left turn in front of his client’s motorcycle. Mr. Charder quickly litigated this matter on behalf of the injured motorcycle rider and obtained this settlement in the early stages of litigation.
Mr. Charder obtained his law degree from the Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Center and is admitted to practice in New York State as well as the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.

name: Jeremy Glicksman
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Attorney Jeremy Glicksman is a formidable and results-driven advocate known for his strategic approach to complex legal challenges at Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C.. With a career built on investigating and prosecuting high-stakes financial crimes, organized crime, and cybercrimes, Mr. Glicksman brings a unique and powerful skillset to fighting for injured clients. He combines the relentless pursuit of justice with a sharp ability to dissect intricate cases, making him a staunch opponent to insurance companies and corporate wrongdoers.

Mr. Glicksman’s extensive background includes over 15 years of experience, during which he has honed his leadership and case management abilities. He is distinguished by his superior analytical skills, capable of sifting through massive amounts of electronic and financial evidence to build unshakable cases. His experience coordinating with federal and state agencies ensures that every avenue is explored to secure the maximum recovery for his clients.

A graduate of Hofstra University School of Law, Mr. Glicksman has held leadership roles as Bureau Chief, investigating and prosecuting complex financial and organized crime, and served as a manager at Deloitte Advisory. He is admitted to practice law in New York and Connecticut.

name: Sitara Abbas
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Sitara Abbas is a New York personal injury attorney who fights for accident victims and their families. She represents clients in car accidents, slip-and-fall injuries, premises liability, assault and battery cases, and toxic tort litigation.

Before focusing on plaintiff representation, Sitara worked as a defense attorney handling complex litigation for corporations and insurers. This background gives her valuable insight into the strategies insurance companies use to avoid paying claims — knowledge she now uses to secure better results for her injured clients.

In addition to her legal experience, Sitara holds an M.B.A. in Risk Management and Insurance, giving her an insider’s perspective on how insurance companies write policies, evaluate claims, and negotiate settlements.

Sitara earned her J.D. from Hofstra Law and a B.S. in Finance from St. John’s University, along with her M.B.A. in Risk Management and Insurance. She is known for her commitment to justice, having also represented children and young adults in Family and Immigration Court through Hofstra Law’s Clinic.

name: Amir Ali
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Amir Ali is a fierce advocate for the injured, bringing to every case a rare combination of courtroom experience, a depth of legal knowledge that extends well beyond personal injury alone, and an unrelenting commitment to results.
His background spans multiple areas of law and both sides of the adversarial process making him a formidable and well-rounded litigator.

Before joining Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers P.C., Ali practiced on both sides of the criminal justice system. Beginning as a defense attorney, he developed a razor-sharp ability to dismantle the opposition’s case, challenge evidence, and protect clients under pressure. As a prosecutor, he honed the discipline of constructing airtight cases with precision, commanding a courtroom, and delivering results. Ali now brings that same zealous advocacy to every injured plaintiff he represents.
Ali earned his J.D. from Touro Law and is admitted to practice in New York State as well as the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York.

name: Alexandra (Alex) Stata
title: Personal Injury Attorney
about: Alexandra (“Alex”) Stata is a natural trial advocate known for her zealous representation of clients facing complex legal disputes. She prides herself on guiding injured individuals through some of the most challenging moments of their lives, delivering strategic and compassionate advocacy from case inception through resolution. Ms. Stata has a keen ability to tailor her approach to each client’s unique circumstances.

Ms. Stata has vast experience on both sides of civil litigation, spanning criminal prosecution, personal injury and medical malpractice defense, and plaintiff-side employment discrimination. Notably, Ms. Stata competed nationally as a trial advocate in law school, where she was named Best Advocate at the 2023 National Mock Trial Competition and earned the Professor Keith Sullivan Award for professionalism and integrity in advocacy. This exposure to both sides of litigation gives her a sharp eye for case development and the ability to challenge the opposition case with unwavering commitment to the strongest possible outcome.
Ms. Stata obtained her law degree from the Elisabeth Haub School of Law at Pace University and her bachelor’s degree from Syracuse University.

name: Sean Jacoby
title: Trial Attorney
about: Sean Jacoby is a trial attorney by trade and a former prosecutor who brings to the table extensive courtroom experience and an unwavering commitment to client advocacy. Mr. Jacoby has developed a reputation in the trial world for being a passionate advocate with an ability to navigate high-stakes matters with both confidence and precision. Having developed these skills in the demanding environment of criminal prosecution, Mr. Jacoby brings a unique perspective and a trial-tested approach to every personal injury case.

Mr. Jacoby’s passion for trial advocacy extends beyond the courtroom. Mr. Jacoby served as the Executive Director of the Pace Law Advocacy Program and competed nationally in mock trial competitions. Since graduating from law school, Mr. Jacoby returned to Pace Law to coach its mock trial team. As a coach and as a law student, Mr. Jacoby gained experience and developed a deep understanding of both Plaintiff and Defense Personal Injury and Medical Malpractice litigation.
Mr. Jacoby obtained his law degree from the Elisabeth Haub School of Law at Pace University and his bachelor’s degree from Iona University.
